{{Top|leg}}
'''Ortoz''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and the leader of a research team on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He found the former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] known as [[Mort]] lying on the jungle floor of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], wounded by a native animal. He saw the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] as a source of incredible potential and began to conduct a series of gruesome experiments on him. Eventually, Mort regained enough of his strength to put a permanent end to the experiments, likely killing Ortoz in the process.
